zh.headline: Anthropic 让 Claude 自主审核并提交代码
headline_alt: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6.2 Sol 与 Astra 数学突破
黄仁勋两周后回归英伟达，特朗普称其介入
zh.observation: 今天最实质的进展不在模型参数，而在“谁来做决定”：Claude Ship 让 agent 自己 approve PR，Intent Contracts 干脆把工具从规划模型手里拿走，交给一个可信小模型执行——agent 的权限设计正在从“能不能做”转向“由谁签字”。GLM-5.4 的 loop transformer 与 Self-WSP 指向同一条线索：用更少的参数、更多的迭代换能力，scaling 的叙事正在被架构效率稀释。黄仁勋两周内去而复返、特朗普公开认领介入，这件事对 AI 产业的实际影响不是八卦，而是英伟达的出口管制立场与供应链政策将进入更不确定的政治周期，12 月 1 日的国会作证是关键节点。最后，LeCun 与 Dario 的公开对撕和 OpenAI 推动 perplexity 成为行业统一度量，本质是同一场争夺：谁来定义“危险”，谁就掌握规则。

items.title: Anthropic 发布 Claude Ship
items.desc: Claude 现在可以自主 review、修复并 approve GitHub pull request，Code Review 已 GA，PR Steward 与 Claude Approvals 两个 agent 面向 Team/Enterprise 公测。
items.value: AI 生成代码堆积后的审核瓶颈被 agent 接管，CI 流程需重新设计

items.title: OpenAI 将 GPT-6.2 Sol 设为 ChatGPT 默认模型
items.desc: 全球推送，内部测试中图像理解从 47.4% 提升至 71.7%，复杂指令正确率 78.1%，安全策略遵循度同步提升。
items.value: 多模态与指令遵循双升，依赖图像理解的产品可重新评估 baseline

items.title: GPT-6.2 Astra 独立完成 Smoktunowicz 间隙定理的 Lean 机器可验证证明
items.desc: 因 Mathlib 缺少关键基础，模型自行设计了证明策略；Autoform-Hard 上以 56 题解出 49 题登顶。
items.value: 形式化数学进入可验证阶段，AI 开始补全自身依赖的数学基础设施

items.title: Z.ai 发布 GLM-5.4：750B Loop Transformer
items.desc: 28 个 GLM-5 层各跑两遍，官方称可对标 2–3 万亿参数模型；目前仅有 30B 测试模型 benchmark，API 与开放权重待安全评估后放出。
items.value: 循环架构以参数换深度，为中小团队提供新的 scaling 路径参考

items.title: Amazon 以 75 亿美元收购 Decart 的 AI 优化技术与研究团队
items.desc: 为其对外销售 Trainium 芯片做准备。
items.value: 自研芯片竞争从硬件转向推理优化软件栈

items.title: 黄仁勋回归英伟达 CEO，特朗普称亲自介入董事会
items.desc: 距其 11 月 12 日辞职仅约两周，白宫称总统“全程参与”；国会两党批评，黄仁勋将于 12 月 1 日赴众议院作证。
items.value: 公司治理与政治干预边界被打破，供应链与出口管制政策不确定性上升

items.title: 美国拟将亚洲 AI 公司 Megaspeed 列入黑名单
items.desc: 涉黄仁勋丑闻的核心公司，被禁后除非获联邦特别许可，否则不得与美国企业往来。
items.value: 芯片转运与东南亚中转网络成为出口管制执法重点

items.title: OpenAI 与 Cisco 推出 Shirudo 开源运行时
items.desc: 面向 Linux 的开源运行时，帮助团队在滚动打补丁期间保护正在运行的系统。
items.value: 补丁窗口期的运行时防护，可直接用于生产环境安全加固

items.title: Google Search AI Mode 接入 Drive 与 Wallet
items.desc: Personal Intelligence 扩展至 Drive、Wallet 与 Gemini app，用生态内用户数据生成个性化回答。
items.value: 搜索从“查信息”转向“读你的私人上下文”，隐私边界成产品竞争点

items.title: Oregon 与 Virginia 两州起诉 SpaceX 及 Grok 深度伪造
items.desc: 指控其未落实行业标准防护、虚假宣传平台安全性，涉及真实人物（含儿童）的性化图像。
items.value: 州级消费者保护诉讼成为 AI 生成内容监管的实际执行路径

items.title: 蚂蚁 OceanBase 发布湖库一体 AI 数据平台 OceanLake，核心引擎全球开源
items.desc: 面向 AI 负载统一湖与库。
items.value: AI 数据栈国产方案再添开源选项，可评估替代现有湖仓组合

items.title: 国产端侧模型实测：1450 亿参数塞进笔记本，80+ token/s
items.desc: 零 token 成本、断网可用，主打本地 Vibe Coding 场景。
items.value: 端侧大参数模型可行性提升，本地 coding agent 成本模型被改写

items.title: Self-WSP：语言模型通过权重空间编程自我改进
items.desc: Qwen3.5-0.8B 读取自身权重、提出编辑并继续用编辑后权重同时充当解题者与编辑者，GSM8K 准确率有真实提升。
items.value: 模型自改权重不再只是微调，WSP 或成新的能力注入范式

items.title: Search-Native Pretraining：把搜索能力前置到预训练
items.desc: 用本地索引为大规模语料增强搜索查询与网页响应，训练阶段即习得检索能力，而非依赖 post-training。
items.value: 检索增强从推理时技巧变为预训练目标，RAG 架构可能被重构

items.title: Intent Contracts：把工具从 agent 手里拿走
items.desc: 规划模型不持有任何工具，每步提交含目标、用户原话引用与范围字段的合约，由小可信模型校验并自行写出工具调用。
items.value: 给出可审计的 agent 授权接口，直接可用于高风险工具调用场景

items.title: MemOnce：面向 LLM 的可扩展记忆架构
items.desc: 在 KV cache 线性增长与线性架构细节丢失之间取折中，维持可复用记忆状态。
items.value: 长程持续交互的显存瓶颈有新解法，长上下文部署成本可降

items.title: Non-penetrating World Models 与 NoPeBench
items.desc: 首个评估世界模型如何应对物理障碍的 benchmark，发现现有开源模型均无法可靠防止物体穿透，但 DiT 隐状态中已编码所需信息。
items.value: 世界模型物理一致性有可量化缺口，也提示低成本修复路径

items.title: ComplexIF：多轮多约束指令遵循 benchmark
items.desc: 现有指令遵循 benchmark 已饱和，该基准将多条约束分散到对话不同轮次并要求全部成立，附自动生成流水线。
items.value: 为 agent 与对话产品提供更贴近真实使用的评测集

items.title: Google DeepMind：用 agent 团队与形式化验证寻找更快的量子算法
items.desc: 面向核聚变与化学计算场景改进量子算法。
items.value: agent + 形式化验证的组合在科学发现流程中跑通闭环

items.title: obra/superpowers（今日 +840 star）
items.desc: 一套 agentic skills 框架与软件开发方法论，强调可落地的工作流而非 prompt 集合。
items.value: 为 coding agent 提供可复用的技能组织方式，值得对照现有 agent 栈

items.title: jingyaogong/minimind（今日 +828 star）
items.desc: 两小时从零训练一个 64M 参数大模型，全流程教学式实现。
items.value: 理解 LLM 训练全链路的最低成本入口，适合团队内训

items.title: Meta TLX：把 warp-group 控制带进 Triton
items.desc: 为 Python Triton kernel 增加 warp-group、barrier、TMA 与 cluster 控制，已在 Hopper、Blackwell 与 AMD MI350 上跑 Meta 的广告与 LLM 负载。
items.value: Triton 与手写 CUDA 的性能差距进一步收窄，跨厂商 kernel 复用性提升

items.title: Architect Labs 发布 Frostbite：AI 设计的 interaction net CPU
items.desc: agent 从理论推进到 7nm GDS，流片前测试显示每瓦性能为顺序执行核心的 4.59 倍。
items.value: AI 参与芯片微架构设计的完整案例，值得关注其方法而非数字

items.title: LeCun 与 Dario 之争引爆 HN（1384 分、768 评论）
items.desc: LeCun 在 X 上称“Dario 夸大危险是为了让开源模型非法、从而保持自己的控制权”，把 Anthropic 的 AI 安全叙事直接定性为监管俘获。
items.value: 开源 vs 闭源的安全话语权之争已进入公开对抗，将影响监管走向

items.title: OpenAI 首次公开 GPT 全系 perplexity 曲线并呼吁行业共享阈值
items.desc: 首席科学家 Jakub Pachocki 披露核心能力在相当精确的阈值处涌现，主张把 perplexity 作为行业统一的进展度量，并在行为控制力衰减前建立共同上限；同期 Alexandr Wang 称 Riemann 猜想的 AI 辅助证明草图意味着超级智能近在眼前。
items.value: 能力评测从各家自说自话转向统一度量，安全阈值或成合规抓手

en.headline: Anthropic lets Claude review and submit code autonomously
headline_alt: OpenAI releases GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra math breakthrough
Jensen Huang returns to Nvidia in two weeks, Trump says he intervened
en.observation: Today's most substantive progress is not in model parameters but in "who gets to decide": Claude Ship lets agents approve PRs themselves, and Intent Contracts simply takes tools away from the planning model and hands execution to a trusted small model—agent permission design is shifting from "can it do this" to "who signs off." GLM-5.4's loop transformer and Self-WSP point to the same thread: trading fewer parameters and more iterations for capability, as the scaling narrative is diluted by architectural efficiency. Jensen Huang's reversal within two weeks and Trump's public claim of involvement matter to the AI industry not as gossip but because Nvidia's export-control stance and supply-chain policy are entering a more uncertain political cycle, with the December 1 congressional testimony a key milestone. Finally, the public LeCun–Dario spat and OpenAI's push for perplexity as an industry-wide metric are essentially the same contest: whoever defines "danger" controls the rules.

items.title: Anthropic releases Claude Ship
items.desc: Claude can now autonomously review, fix, and approve GitHub pull requests; Code Review is GA, and two agents, PR Steward and Claude Approvals, are in public beta for Team/Enterprise.
items.value: Agents take over the review bottleneck from piled-up AI-generated code; CI pipelines need redesign

items.title: OpenAI makes GPT-6.2 Sol the default ChatGPT model
items.desc: Rolled out globally; in internal tests image understanding rose from 47.4% to 71.7%, complex-instruction accuracy reached 78.1%, and safety-policy compliance improved as well.
items.value: Multimodal and instruction-following both improve; image-dependent products should re-evaluate baselines

items.title: GPT-6.2 Astra independently completes a Lean machine-verifiable proof of the Smoktunowicz gap theorem
items.desc: Because Mathlib lacked key foundations, the model designed its own proof strategy; on Autoform-Hard it solved 49 of 56 problems to top the leaderboard.
items.value: Formal math enters a verifiable phase; AI begins filling in the math infrastructure it depends on

items.title: Z.ai releases GLM-5.4: a 750B Loop Transformer
items.desc: 28 GLM-5 layers each run twice; the company claims it rivals 2–3 trillion parameter models; currently only a 30B test model has benchmarks, with API and open weights pending safety evaluation.
items.value: Looped architecture trades parameters for depth, offering smaller teams a new scaling reference

items.title: Amazon acquires Decart's AI optimization tech and research team for $7.5B
items.desc: A move to prepare for selling Trainium chips externally.
items.value: Custom-chip competition shifts from hardware to inference-optimization software stacks

items.title: Jensen Huang returns as Nvidia CEO; Trump says he personally intervened with the board
items.desc: Only about two weeks after his November 12 resignation; the White House says the president was "involved throughout"; both parties in Congress criticize the move, and Huang will testify before the House on December 1.
items.value: The boundary between corporate governance and political intervention breaks down; supply-chain and export-control uncertainty rises

items.title: US plans to blacklist Asian AI company Megaspeed
items.desc: The company at the center of the Jensen Huang scandal; once banned, it cannot deal with US firms without special federal permission.
items.value: Chip transshipment and Southeast Asian relay networks become export-control enforcement priorities

items.title: OpenAI and Cisco launch the Shirudo open-source runtime
items.desc: An open-source Linux runtime that helps teams protect running systems during rolling patch deployment.
items.value: Runtime protection during patch windows, directly usable for production security hardening

items.title: Google Search AI Mode connects to Drive and Wallet
items.desc: Personal Intelligence expands to Drive, Wallet, and the Gemini app, using in-ecosystem user data to generate personalized answers.
items.value: Search shifts from "looking up information" to "reading your private context"; privacy boundaries become a competitive point

items.title: Oregon and Virginia sue SpaceX and Grok over deepfakes
items.desc: Alleging failure to implement industry-standard safeguards and false claims about platform safety, involving sexualized images of real people (including children).
items.value: State consumer-protection lawsuits become the practical enforcement path for AI-generated content regulation

items.title: Ant Group's OceanBase releases OceanLake, a lake-warehouse unified AI data platform, with its core engine open-sourced globally
items.desc: Unifying lakes and warehouses for AI workloads.
items.value: Another open-source option in the domestic AI data stack; can be evaluated against existing lakehouse combos

items.title: Real-world test of a domestic on-device model: 145B parameters crammed into a laptop, 80+ token/s
items.desc: Zero token cost and usable offline, targeting local vibe coding scenarios.
items.value: Large-parameter on-device models become more feasible; the cost model for local coding agents is rewritten

items.title: Self-WSP: Language Models Self-Improve via Weight-Space Programming
items.desc: Qwen3.5-0.8B reads its own weights, proposes edits, and then uses the edited weights to act as both solver and editor, yielding genuine gains in GSM8K accuracy.
items.value: Self-editing weights beyond fine-tuning; WSP may become a new capability-injection paradigm

items.title: Search-Native Pretraining: Moving Search Capability into Pretraining
items.desc: Uses a local index to augment search queries and web responses over large-scale corpora, so retrieval ability is acquired during training rather than relying on post-training.
items.value: Retrieval augmentation shifts from inference-time trick to pretraining objective; RAG architectures may be restructured

items.title: Intent Contracts: Taking Tools Out of the Agent's Hands
items.desc: The planning model holds no tools; each step submits a contract containing the goal, verbatim user quotes, and scope fields, which a small trusted model validates and then writes the tool calls itself.
items.value: Provides an auditable agent authorization interface, directly usable for high-risk tool-call scenarios

items.title: MemOnce: A Scalable Memory Architecture for LLMs
items.desc: Strikes a compromise between linearly growing KV cache and loss of detail in linear architectures, maintaining a reusable memory state.
items.value: New solution to VRAM bottlenecks in long-running interaction; long-context deployment costs can drop

items.title: Non-penetrating World Models and NoPeBench
items.desc: The first benchmark evaluating how world models handle physical obstacles; finds existing open-source models cannot reliably prevent object penetration, but the needed information is already encoded in DiT hidden states.
items.value: Quantifies a physical-consistency gap in world models and hints at a low-cost fix

items.title: ComplexIF: A Multi-turn, Multi-constraint Instruction-following Benchmark
items.desc: Existing instruction-following benchmarks are saturated; this benchmark spreads multiple constraints across different turns of a conversation and requires all to hold, with an automatic generation pipeline.
items.value: Gives agents and conversational products an evaluation set closer to real-world use

items.title: Google DeepMind: Finding Faster Quantum Algorithms with Agent Teams and Formal Verification
items.desc: Improves quantum algorithms for nuclear fusion and chemistry computing scenarios.
items.value: The agent + formal verification combination closes the loop in the scientific discovery process

items.title: obra/superpowers (+840 stars today)
items.desc: An agentic skills framework and software development methodology that emphasizes actionable workflows rather than a collection of prompts.
items.value: Gives coding agents a reusable way to organize skills; worth comparing with existing agent stacks

items.title: jingyaogong/minimind (+828 stars today)
items.desc: Train a 64M-parameter large model from scratch in two hours, with a full tutorial-style implementation.
items.value: Lowest-cost entry to understanding the full LLM training pipeline; good for internal training

items.title: Meta TLX: Bringing warp-group control to Triton
items.desc: Adds warp-group, barrier, TMA, and cluster control to Python Triton kernels; already runs Meta's ads and LLM workloads on Hopper, Blackwell, and AMD MI350.
items.value: Narrows Triton's performance gap with hand-written CUDA and improves cross-vendor kernel reuse

items.title: Architect Labs releases Frostbite: an AI-designed interaction-net CPU
items.desc: The agent advanced from theory to 7nm GDS; pre-tapeout tests show 4.59x performance per watt versus a sequential-execution core.
items.value: A complete case of AI in chip microarchitecture design; focus on method, not numbers

items.title: LeCun vs. Dario debate ignites HN (1,384 points, 768 comments)
items.desc: On X, LeCun said "Dario exaggerates the danger to make open-source models illegal and thereby preserve his own control," directly framing Anthropic's AI safety narrative as regulatory capture.
items.value: The open- vs. closed-source safety narrative fight is now open confrontation and will shape regulation.

items.title: OpenAI publishes GPT-family perplexity curves for the first time and calls for industry-shared thresholds
items.desc: Chief scientist Jakub Pachocki disclosed that core capabilities emerge at fairly precise thresholds, argued for perplexity as an industry-wide progress metric, and urged shared caps before behavioral control degrades; meanwhile Alexandr Wang said an AI-assisted proof sketch of the Riemann Hypothesis means superintelligence is imminent.
items.value: Capability evaluation shifts from fragmented self-reporting to a unified metric; safety thresholds could become a compliance lever.
